(data source schema)
    description: Coralogix log parsing rules. Parsing rules transform unstructured log data into structured fields at ingestion time. For more info please review - https://coralogix.com/docs/user-guides/data-transformation/parsing/log-parsing-rules/.
active  tftypes.Bool computed
    description: Determines whether the rule-group will be active.
applications  tftypes.Set[tftypes.String] computed
    description: Rules will execute on logs that match the following applications.
creator  tftypes.String computed
    description: Rule-group creator.
description  tftypes.String computed
    description: Rule-group description
hidden  tftypes.Bool computed
id  tftypes.String required
name  tftypes.String computed
    description: Rule-group name
order  tftypes.Number computed
    description: Determines the index of the rule-group between the other rule-groups. By default, will be added last. (1 based indexing). The value must be unique across every rule-group in the account. Terraform cannot enforce that, because rule-groups are separate resources that are planned in isolation, so two rule-groups sharing an order are only rejected - if at all - by the API.
rule_subgroups  nested LIST computed
    description: List of rule-subgroups. Every rule-subgroup is a list of rules linked with a logical 'OR' (||) operation.
rule_subgroups.active  tftypes.Bool computed
rule_subgroups.id  tftypes.String computed
rule_subgroups.order  tftypes.Number computed
rule_subgroups.rules  nested LIST computed
rule_subgroups.rules.block  nested SINGLE computed
rule_subgroups.rules.block.active  tftypes.Bool computed
    description: Determines whether the rule will be active or not.
rule_subgroups.rules.block.block_all_matching_blocks  tftypes.Bool computed
    description: Block Logic. If true or nor set - blocking all matching blocks, if false - blocking all non-matching blocks.
rule_subgroups.rules.block.description  tftypes.String computed
    description: The rule description.
rule_subgroups.rules.block.id  tftypes.String computed
    description: The rule id.
rule_subgroups.rules.block.keep_blocked_logs  tftypes.Bool computed
    description: Determines if to view blocked logs in LiveTail and archive to S3.
rule_subgroups.rules.block.name  tftypes.String computed
    description: The rule name.
rule_subgroups.rules.block.order  tftypes.Number computed
    description: Determines the index of the rule inside the rule-subgroup. Will be computed by the order it was declared (1-based indexing).
rule_subgroups.rules.block.regular_expression  tftypes.String computed
    description: Regular expiration. More info: https://coralogix.com/blog/regex-101/
rule_subgroups.rules.block.source_field  tftypes.String computed
    description: The field on which the Regex will operate on. Accepts lowercase only.
